messages.text:
I’ll build the Python port from the local Rust source and the recorded reference binary only.

The finish line is a root executable whose CLI behavior matches status/stdout/stderr, so I’m first reading the CLI contract and core search/decrypt paths once, then I’ll patch the Python implementation and compile wrapper.
